payload.title: claude launches a persona with --agent
payload.body: Claude Code 2.1 has a native persona launch: 'claude --agent <name>' runs the main session as that agent (also the 'agent' setting). It is the claude face of what omp's generated launcher does, so claude needs no launcher script: the projected agent file already is the persona. Open question for the build: whether the main-session agent receives the agent's 'skills' the way a dispatched one does, which omp's launcher had to inline by hand (not yet observed on claude).
